summary: Medama Analytics is a self-hosted website analytics tool designed to track visitor traffic without relying on cookies. Built using Go, it aims to provide a lightweight alternative to heavier tracking suites while prioritising user privacy. It collects visitor data directly on your own infrastructure.
goodFor: It is a good fit for operators who want basic traffic metrics without compliance overheads like cookie banners.
watchOut: The project has a relatively modest community size and slowing development activity, which might impact long-term support and feature growth.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed as a Docker container, deployment typically involves setting up persistent volumes for data storage and placing it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
